sn54.10:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kimbilāyaṃ viharati veḷuvane.
sn54.10:1.3: tatra kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ kimbilaṃ āmantesi:
sn54.10:1.4: “kathaṃ bhāvito kho kimbila, ānāpānasatisamādhi kathaṃ bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃsoti.
sn54.10:2.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā kimbilo tuṇhī ahosi.
sn54.10:2.2: dutiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ kimbilaṃ āmantesi …pe…
sn54.10:2.3: tatiya tā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ kimbilaṃ āmantesi:
sn54.10:2.4: “kathaṃ bhāvimepi kho, kimbila, ānāpānasatisamādhi kathaṃ bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso”ti.
sn54.10:2.5: tatiyampi kho āyasmā kimbilo tuṇhī ahosi.
sn54.10:3.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn54.10:3.3: yaṃ bhagavā ānāpānasatisamādhiṃ bhāseyya. bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī”ti.
sn54.10:4.2: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
sn54.10:4.4: “kathaṃ bhāvito ca ānanda, ānāpānasatisamādhi kathaṃ bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso:
sn54.10:4.5: idhānanda, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā
sn54.10:4.8: evaṃ bhāvito kho ānanda, ānāpānasatisamādhi evaṃ bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso.
sn54.10:5.1: yasmiṃ samaye ānanda, bhikkhu dīghaṃ vā assasanto dīghaṃ assasāmīti pajānāti, dīghaṃ vā passasanto dīghaṃ passasāmīti pajānāti,
sn54.10:5.2: rassaṃ vā assasanto rassaṃ assasāmīti pajānāti, rassaṃ vā passasanto rassaṃ passasāmīti pajānāti,
sn54.10:5.3: sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmīti sikkhati, sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmīti sikkhati,
sn54.10:5.4: passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmīti sikkhati, passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmīti sikkhati,
sn54.10:5.5: kāye kāyānupassī ānanda, bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn54.10:5.7: kāyaññatarāhaṃ ānanda, etaṃ vadāmi yadidaṃ assāsapassāsaṃ.
sn54.10:5.8: tasmātihānanda, kāye kāyānupassī bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn54.10:6.1: yasmiṃ samaye ānanda, bhikkhu pītipaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmīti sikkhati, pītipaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.10:6.2: sukhapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmīti sikkhati, sukhapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmīti sikkhati,
sn54.10:6.3: cittasaṅkhārapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmīti sikkhati, cittasaṅkhārapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmīti sikkhati, passambhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmīti sikkhati,
sn54.10:6.5: vedanāsu vedanānupassī ānanda, bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn54.10:6.7: vedanaññatarāhaṃ ānanda, etaṃ vadāmi yadidaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ sādhukaṃ manasikāraṃ.
sn54.10:6.8: tasmātihānanda, vedanāsu vedanānupassī bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn54.10:7.1: yasmiṃ samaye ānanda, bhikkhu cittapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmīti sikkhati, cittapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmīti sikkhati,
sn54.10:7.2: abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmīti sikkhati, abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmīti sikkhati,
sn54.10:7.3: samādahaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmīti sikkhati, samādahaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmīti sikkhati,
sn54.10:7.4: vimocayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmīti sikkhati, vimocayaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmīti sikkhati,
sn54.10:7.5: citte cittānupassī ānanda, bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn54.10:7.7: nāhaṃ ānanda, muṭṭhassatissa asampajānassa ānāpānasatisamādhibhāvanaṃ vadāmi.
sn54.10:7.8: tasmātihānanda, citte cittānupassī bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn54.10:8.1: yasmiṃ samaye ānanda, bhikkhu aniccānupassī assasissāmīti sikkhati, aniccānupassī passasissāmīti sikkhati,
sn54.10:8.2: virāgānupassī assasissāmīti sikkhati, virāgānupassī passasissāmīti sikkhati,
sn54.10:8.3: nirodhānupassī assasissāmīti sikkhati, nirodhānupassī passasissāmīti sikkhati,
sn54.10:8.4: paṭinissaggānupassī assasissāmīti sikkhati, paṭinissaggānupassī passasissāmīti sikkhati,
sn54.10:8.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī ānanda, bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn54.10:8.6: so yaṃ taṃ hoti abhijjhādomanassānaṃ pahānaṃ taṃ paññāya disvā dissā sādhukaṃ ajjhupekkhitā hoti.
sn54.10:8.7: tasmātihānanda, dhammesu dhammānupassī bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn54.10:9.2: puratthimāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya sakaṭaṃ vā ratho vā, upahanateva taṃ paṃsupuñjaṃ.
sn54.10:9.5: dakkhiṇāya ce’pi disāya āgaccheyya sakaṭaṃ vā ratho vā upahanateva taṃ paṃsupuñjaṃ.
sn54.10:9.6: evameva kho ānanda, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharanto’pi upahanateva pāpake akusale dhamme,
sn54.10:9.9: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharanto’pi upahanateva pāpake akusale dhammeti.
